pointers.sentence: Each runs as a child process through `popen_wrapper` (`django/core/management/utils.py:popen_wrapper`).

A command first looks for each on PATH with `find_command`, and stops with a `CommandError` asking for GNU gettext 0.19 or newer when one is missing; the version is not checked (`django/core/management/commands/makemessages.py:check_programs`).
The command's `Command.handle` works in this order (`django/core/management/commands/makemessages.py:Command.handle`):
In the `"django"` domain a file not ending `.py`, a `.js` file added with `--extension` too, is read as a template (`django/core/management/commands/makemessages.py:BuildFile.is_templatized`).

The first is the default, made if missing (`django/core/management/commands/makemessages.py:Command.handle`). makemessages sets `BaseCommand.requires_settings` false; run without settings, it has no `LOCALE_PATHS` and skips neither `MEDIA_ROOT` nor `STATIC_ROOT`.
A file with none above it goes to the default; with no default, a message in it stops the command with a `CommandError` (`django/core/management/commands/makemessages.py:Command.find_files`).
`Command.process_locale_dir` handles one locale directory's files together, making a `BuildFile` for each (`django/core/management/commands/makemessages.py:Command.process_locale_dir`).

A file of the `"django"` domain that is not Python is templatized: `BuildFile.preprocess` rewrites it with `django.utils.translation.templatize` and writes the result beside it, its name with `.py` added, `"arrivals.html.py"` (`django/core/management/commands/makemessages.py:BuildFile.preprocess`).

`Command.xgettext_options` adds `"--add-comments=Translators"`: as the documentation says, a comment beginning "Translators" on the line before a message appears with it in the `.po` file (`docs/topics/i18n/translation.txt`).

`BuildFile.postprocess_messages` puts each template's path back where the `#:` lines name its copy, `write_pot_file` writes the `.pot` file, the copies are deleted, and msguniq is run over each `.pot` file (`django/core/management/commands/makemessages.py:Command.build_potfiles`).
`django.utils.translation.templatize` turns a Django template into text in which xgettext, reading Python, finds the template's messages (`django/utils/translation/template.py:templatize`).

The rest, but comments, goes through `blankout`, which turns each character that is not whitespace into a letter: B for a tag, X for text, F for a filter, S and P for a block's singular and plural (`django/utils/translation/template.py:blankout`).

An existing file msgmerge updates in place, keeping its translations; the documentation notes that an entry may come out fuzzy, its translation inferred from strings translated before (`docs/topics/i18n/translation.txt`).
With `--no-obsolete`, msgattrib then removes the obsolete messages (`docs/ref/django-admin.txt`).

It compiles the `.po` files of the locales of `--locale`, else of every one found, less those of `--exclude`; where that leaves none, of every locale, the excluded too (`django/core/management/commands/compilemessages.py:Command.handle`).

Each remaining file goes to a thread pool that runs msgfmt with `"--check-format"`: the documentation shows compilemessages failing where a translation's format specifications differ from its message's (`docs/topics/i18n/translation.txt`).
A failure does not stop the others; the command ends with one `CommandError` (`django/core/management/commands/compilemessages.py:Command.compile_messages`).
